notes.title: Update 2 includes a new weapon, the Orbitor, plus other improvements:
notes.content:
[h1]UPDATE 2: [/h1] February 19, 2017, 

Update 2 is now Active. 

UPDATE 2: February 19, 2017: Automatically overwrites prior game file. 
+Adjusted Collision Detection of enemies being hurt by player, requiring more precision when lining up attacks. 
+Added new Orbitor Weapon option. You can have 2 or more orbitors rotating around the player for multi hit destruction. 
+Bullets now much more effective when hitting foreground overlapping enemies while also going past barrels and boxes. 
+Other minor adjustments and fixes. 

[url=http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27575220/7985b75ee350dbae2c7669b9cd1c62afa6ed9f0c.png][img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27575220/43725e121b167207a54fe20e43944461cf15deac.png[/img][/url]

To immediately test the new Orbitor weapon, select Practice mode and walk past the ? boxes, and you'll see a red small orb on the ground. Walk over it and it will activate the Orbitor. 
---------------------------------------------------------
More Details found in Update Discussions. 

+New Weapon Pick Up: The Orbitor rotates around the player like an option from Gradius, smashing into enemies and wiping them out. It moves slow enough that you'll have to time it so it'll hit the enemy you're aiming for if you're on the move, adding a new strategy to your attacks, or just a useful secondary weapon as you continue to fight. The difference between the Orbitor and the Orb Shield is the Orbitor is a tiny red orb that rotates clockwise, while the Orb Shield protects the player with a large shield.

notes.title: COR: Streets of Rott UPDATE 1 Now Active.
notes.content:
[h1]COR: Streets of Rott UPDATE[/h1]  

Thanks to gamer feedback, Streets of Rott has been given the following improvements in Update 1. (More details found in Update - Discussion)

Update 1 is now Active as of February 17, 2017.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27575220/831ae204abed166af9cfb90ba187c5ff50273b3e.png[/img]

UPDATE 1 DETAILS:
February 17, 2017: Size 520 MB, automatically overwrites prior game file.
+Adjusted Collision Detection of player being hurt by enemies to make it more forgiving.
+Added Blood Splat Effects & Worms OFF button by pressing the letter i key on your keyboard, as described in the game’s Options.
+Crawler enemy adjusted so he doesn’t crawl above player reach.
+Tall Door Zombies more forgiving and die on one shot from gun as well as with barrels, boxes, power shots.
+Some new enemy movement patterns.
+Backspace is the sole button to exit the program aside from exiting via the X button at the top left corner of the window. This frees up the F12 key. Esc is still the pause button.
+Other minor adjustments.

notes.title: 7 Days till the Streets of Rott for PC, Mac, Linux! Unique focus on Destruction & Trading Cards
notes.content:
[h1]Unique focus on Destruction[/h1]

With less than 7 days till City of Rott: Streets of Rott premieres on Steam, February 14, 2017 for PC, Mac and Linux for $2.99, one feature that helps set this game apart aside from the style and fight moves, will be the unique focus on destruction. 

An endless horde of Rotters want to turn you into the living dead just like them, but with your power shot & guns, resist by destroying junk cars, rubble, and debris scattered about the environment to eliminate them first. You have the right to exist; to not be another brain dead corpse. Fight back!!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27575220/182477171fefbd51dde9dc3a20925a48c2f6d4d6.png[/img]

Grab a weapon and fire a few shots at a junk car, and when the car boils bright red with the enemy lurking nearby, fire again, obliterating the car into an explosive blast! The rotten undead will be evaporated in the blaze! 

And while it's always your choice how you decide to fight back, this strategy will be a big factor to your success in the Streets of Rott. Just be careful not to get caught in the fire. 

Remember, if you're harmed in the game, seek out the hidden, big scoring, health regenerating, Free Life Health Hearts throughout the game. If you can't find 'em, then stock up on Zombifate pills to keep yourself fighting. 

And don't forget about the collectible [b] Streets of Rott Trading Cards,[/b] Emoticons, Badges and Backgrounds exclusive to this game! Collect 'em all!

So mark your calendar for City of Rott: Streets of Rott next Tuesday, February 14th, 2017 and show the Rotter hordes you'll never be one of them.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27575220/91819cd92991a841466cbd984bd48174d3846adf.png[/img]

tags.feature: And don't forget about the collectible Streets of Rott Trading Cards, Emoticons, Badges and Backgrounds exclusive to this game! Collect 'em all!
